_comment: Synthetic data for demonstration only. Not based on any real organization.

organization.name: Riverbend Components (fictional)
organization.description: Machines brackets and housings for a defense prime contractor under a subcontract that includes FAR 52.204-21.
organization.system_boundary: Office and shop-floor Windows computers, one on-premises file server, Microsoft 365 email and file storage, and the office firewall.
organization.fci_types: Purchase orders, drawings marked for contract use, delivery schedules, and contract correspondence.

AC1-1.note: User accounts are managed in Microsoft 365 and on the domain controller; the IT manager keeps the list.

AC1-2.note: Office computers are listed; shop-floor PCs and personal phones are not.

AC1-3.note: All computers require Windows sign-in; Microsoft 365 requires sign-in.

AC2-2.note: Several office users have local administrator rights.

AC3-2.note: Employees use personal phones and home PCs for email without restriction.

AC4-1.note: The office manager approves website and social posts.

AC4-2.note: Reviewed before posting, but no periodic review.

IA1-1.note: Shop floor uses a shared 'floor.kiosk' login.

IA2-2.note: Changed on computers but not on the shop printer and two network switches.

MP1-1.note: Old drives are drilled before disposal; paper goes to a shredding vendor.

PE1-1.note: Office and server closet access limited to staff.

PE1-2.note: Server closet is locked; office has keycard entry.

PE2-3.note: Keycards are issued but not always collected from departing staff.

SC1-1.note: Office firewall at the internet edge.

SC2-1.note: Website is hosted by an external provider; guest Wi-Fi is a separate network.

SI1-2.note: Office PCs update automatically; the file server and shop PCs are patched irregularly.

SI2-1.note: Two shop-floor PCs have no antivirus.
